service_details.name: Federated Documentation Search
service_details.description: Search developer documentation across 47 vendors; results carry vendor, version, license, and canonical source URL.

service_details.name: Error to Docs Matching
service_details.description: Match an error message or stack trace to the closest official documentation sections, with disclaimer.

service_details.name: Source License Lookup
service_details.description: License and attribution information for every documentation source in the mesh.

service_details.name: Documesh MCP Server
service_details.description: The same documentation services over MCP Streamable HTTP with 3 typed tools and MCP Apps UI resources.

payments.note: Documesh is a free open API. No checkout, billing, or payment flows are offered; all services are free of charge.
